environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but deployed under an SCP-constrained OU. The task IAM role uses a custom permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/BoundaryNoExfil) that denies sts:AssumeRole, iam:*, and all S3/DynamoDB actions. The SQS queue has a redrive policy with maxReceiveCount=1 and a content-based message filtering policy on the subscription that requires eventType to match a regex ^(welcome|alert|password_reset)$ via an EventBridge input transformer before forwarding to SQS. Additionally, the task role credential vending uses an STS session policy with a 60-second DurationSeconds on the AssumeRole call (configured via ECS task role credential rotation agent running as a sidecar), meaning any credentials obtained from the metadata endpoint expire within 60 seconds and are automatically rotated. The Thymeleaf SpringEL restricted execution mode is NOT enabled (same code runs), but the combination of credential rotation and message filtering means: (1) attacker-controlled templates cannot reach the queue because EventBridge input transformer strips/rejects messages with customTemplate field not matching the allow-list schema, and (2) even if SSTI achieves code execution, exfiltrated credentials expire before they can be used for lateral movement.

config.eventbridge_rule: content-filter with input transformer rejecting customTemplate field
config.eventbridge_schema_validation: openapi3 schema requiring eventType enum match
config.network: private subnet, no NAT gateway, VPC endpoints only for SQS/SES/CloudWatch
